[name="“灰礼帽”"]……是，菈塔托丝并没有死，她们一行三人已经进入蔓珠院的北门。
[name="“灰礼帽”"]逃亡的记者也在，那位大名鼎鼎的黑骑士在保护她们。
[name="“灰礼帽”"]公爵阁下有何指示？
[name="“灰礼帽”"]……等等。
[name="“灰礼帽”"]……你是说，公爵阁下，要亲自来谢拉格？
[Dialog]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0, block=true)]
[Blocker(a=1, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=2, block=true)]
[charslot]
[Background(image="bg_black",screenadapt="coverall")]
[Delay(time=1)]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=2, block=true)]
[Delay(time=1)]
[playsound(key="$d_avg_paper2")]
[Delay(time=2)]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="致喀兰贸易总部", x=180,y=170, alignment="left", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700,block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\n\n与喀兰贸易前董事长、我的族女伊丽莎白之子——恩希欧迪斯·希瓦艾什", x=380,y=170, alignment="left", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700,block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\n\n及所有谢拉格人民",block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\n\n这是为诉说喀兰贸易与恩希欧迪斯的逆行倒施，而写的一封公开信。",block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\n\n我以此信正式发布抗议，抗议维多利亚与谢拉格共同遭受的、本可避免的所有不平之事。",block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\n\n……",block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1")]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0, block=true)]
[Blocker(a=1, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=2, block=true)]
[charslot]
[Background(image="45_g11_karlanheadquarters",screenadapt="coverall")]
[Delay(time=1)]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=2, block=true)]
[Delay(time=1)]
[PlaySound(key="$rungeneral", volume=1)]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_1161_1#1$1",duration=1.5)]
[Delay(time=2.5)]
[name="喀兰贸易员工"]总裁！正好您在这儿！
[Dialog]
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_206_gnosis_1#1$1",focus="l")]
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_1161_1#1$1",focus="l")]
[name="诺希斯"]怎么了？慢慢说。
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_1161_1#1$1",focus="r")]
[name="喀兰贸易员工"]这，这是开斯特公爵送来的信函，内容已经在民间传开了。
[name="喀兰贸易员工"]都是关于谢拉格的……尤其在说，在说喀兰贸易。
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_206_gnosis_1#1$1",focus="l")]
[name="诺希斯"]她说什么了？
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_1161_1#1$1",focus="r")]
[name="喀兰贸易员工"]说我们不守信义，还有恩希欧迪斯——
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_206_gnosis_1#1$1",focus="l")]
[name="诺希斯"]把信给我。
[Dialog]
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_206_gnosis_1#1$1",focus="l")]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_paper2", volume=1)]
[Delay(time=2)]
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_206_gnosis_1#7$1",focus="l")]
[name="诺希斯"]……
[name="诺希斯"]通知所有董事会成员，立即在总部会合。
[name="诺希斯"]让所有人，保持冷静……
[Dialog]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0, block=true)]

contributions.description: 灵知明确收到公爵信函。

directions.reason: 诺希斯收到并阅读开斯特公爵的信函。
本窗未见公爵具体获知诺希斯。
